accepted_principles: R_X6_PERFORMANCE_001 remains the historical strict conjunctive comparator with unknown sensitivity and specificity.
Correct execution of the historical comparator is distinct from diagnostic validity.
The spent R1.5 attempt remains a failed, motivating historical observation and is not untouched successor evaluation data.
TCP estimator and retransmission-timer behavior cannot be transferred to the successful-reply-only ICMP ping p95.
A prospective applicability limitation cannot redefine the historical task, exclude the spent attempt, alter its outcome, or convert abstention into success.
Predictors and hybrid selection logic exclude identifiers, paths, artifact names, wall-clock or collection timestamps, partition metadata, injection state, labels, and effectiveness classifications.
All windows and artifacts from an attempt remain in one partition, and correlated repetitions or variants remain grouped under a key frozen before collection.
Rule-based, Machine Learning, and hybrid comparison requires the same leakage-reviewed observation boundary and independently held-out experiment attempts.
